release_notes.en-US: Version 2.1.0 adds signed GitHub domain rule packs for faster false-positive fixes, optional public JSON refresh, and updated privacy disclosures. Still no telemetry or remote code.

version.approval_notes: 2.1.0: Signed GitHub rule pack fetch (Ed25519, public JSON only, no user data). alarms permission for refresh schedule. Privacy policy updated. Submitted ZIP is readable unminified source. Support: https://nokaangel.dev/support?project=grandmaguard
